comments.author: RealMo3
comments.body_html: 300 Whisper is the same chambering as 300 BLK, but is designed to be hypersonic for SPR/Bolt actions. Think .223 Wyld chambered AR-15s and Bolt Actions. Its just a chambering of the same dimensions, but a casing/powder load/projectile that is designed to operate at a higher PSI allowing for higher velocities and flatter projectory
